name: mstest-extensions
description: Plan, implement and verify MSTest unit, integration and end-to-end tests, shared fixtures and extensions, using the consumer's resolved APIs and supported build metadata.

interface.longDescription: Implement MSTest data providers, custom assertions, execution attributes and fixtures using version-matched API evidence. Verify real discovery, source navigation, failure behavior and resource ownership.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the MSTest Extensions skill to implement and verify a testing capability in this project's installed MSTest version.
